kdp.title: Developer Notebook: Lined & Dot Grid Pages for Coders
kdp.subtitle: Lined pages and dot grids for sketching, pseudocode, and notes
kdp.description: A plain notebook for software developers. 120 pages of college-ruled lined paper and dot grids. The lined pages are for meeting notes, pseudocode, and design thinking. The dot grids are for sketching wireframes, diagrams, and system architecture. 6 x 9 inches, cream paper, easy to carry in a bag.
